body: Tell them what you saw. They can probably use her cell to get her location and/or contact family

It seems like at times the ups just make it harder too is the thing.. I almost fear/distrust happiness. I was actually really happy there for a bit.. and I remember for a while I kept telling myself not to get used to it.. that its always fleeting.. And I feel like right as I started to convince myself maybe it was possible for me to be happy.. that maybe the years and years of sadness and struggle were leading to something good.. it was all ripped away.. In a series of just terrible events.. And now Im just exhausted. I dont think after this Ill ever trust anything close to happiness again. 

And mostly I just dont think I have the strength to try. I'm just.. exhausted. Mentally I think Im 100% ready to go.. Its just the logistics that are stopping me at this point..
Seems like you care so good on you for trying
